title: Merge PR #203 (dividend foreign-withholding column removal, issue #202) + address CodeRabbit nit
description:
PR #203 (branch fix/dividends-0029-withholding-note) is OPEN, all CI green (test/codecov/GitGuardian pass, CodeRabbit reviewed, 0 actionable). Closes issue #202. Removes the 'Retención EUR' column from the Casilla 0029 detail card + adds a localized redirect note (5 locales) in the 0029 card and main.ts dividends table, gated on withholding>0. Foreign withholding stays in the Casilla 0588 card. Presentation-only; 0029/0588 totals unchanged. 1286 tests pass.

ACTION: decide merge (would be a patch release v0.47.2). One minor CodeRabbit nit to optionally address first: gate the note on the NET withholding total (groups.reduce sum > 0) rather than some(g.withholdingTotalEur>0) — minor because withholdingTaxEur is stored .abs() upstream so they're effectively equivalent today. Needs user merge approval (standing rule: never merge without explicit OK).
close_reason: PR #203 merged (e81631d) — dividend foreign-withholding column removed from Casilla 0029 card; closes issue #202. Releasing as patch v0.47.2.

title: 720: accounts in 720 files written before 0.59.0 read as missing and get origin A
description: Files from DeclaRenta < 0.59.0 stored the account number in positions 132-143 instead of 156-189 (código cuenta). readPrevious720 reads the new position, so an old file's accounts do not match accountCode(cb).code: every account is reported as missing and written with origin A instead of M. Fix: fall back to 132-143 when 156-189 is blank (same follow-up as audit item f), with a fixture from an old file.

title: 720: a margin-debt account reads as a declared account with no balance
description: checkModelo720SuccessiveYear (src/generators/modelo720.ts) lists as accounts.missing every account code from last year's 720 with no positive endingCash this year. An account that is still open but negative (margin debt) is listed too, so the 720 section shows the 'si la cancelaste, debes declarar su cancelación a mano' warning for an open account. Fix: treat an account present in cashBalances with any balance (including negative) as held; only absent accounts are missing. Add a test with endingCash -500.

title: modelo720/721/d6 getEcbRate on year-end positions can throw for a crypto position in an unfetched year
description:
Pre-existing, surfaced (but out of scope) during the v0.47.1 ECB fix (PR #204). The modelo720/721/d6 generators call getEcbRate on OPEN POSITIONS at year-end (a separate flow from the cashTransaction income path that PR #204 fixed). For a crypto/FCY position whose year-end rate was never fetched (e.g. resolvable-but-unfetched, same class as the USDT income bug), getEcbRate throws and could crash that generator.

Not on the main report path; the modelo720/721/d6 calls in main.ts are wrapped in try/catch and Binance emits openPositions=[], so it didn't surface in the adrian report — but it's a latent crash for other broker/position combos.

FIX DIRECTION (mirror PR #204): gate these getEcbRate calls on lookupRateInMap !== null and degrade/warn instead of throwing; and/or ensure the years-to-fetch set covers open-position year-end dates. Audit all getEcbRate call sites in src/generators/modelo720.ts, modelo721.ts, d6.ts and the section-*.ts web counterparts.

Source: code-reviewer flagged this as a non-blocking follow-up while verifying PR #204.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #207 (29a06ec) — Modelo 720/721/D-6 now value year-end positions via non-throwing lookupPositionRate; unvaluable positions skipped + surfaced, no false cancellation records. Released as patch.

title: engine: remaining hints still assume IBKR or print an empty ISIN
description: #391 made fifo.sell_without_lots and fifo.insufficient_lots broker-neutral and dropped the empty '()' when there is no ISIN. Still open: fifo.cover_without_lots (and fifo.cash_buy / corporate-action messages) print '({{isin}})', and the cover_without_lots and option hints (option_expired, exercise, put assignment) talk about a Flex Query. Apply the same isinSuffix and broker-neutral wording where the message can fire for non-IBKR brokers (repo CLAUDE.md rule).

title: i18n: native check of the new Basque, Galician and Catalan strings
description: The audit PRs (P22-P69 and the nine design picks) added many eu, gl and ca strings written by non-native authors. Have a native speaker review them, Basque first. Known spots: month abbreviations (eu Urt…Abe, gl Xan…Dec), 'Etorkizunen gaineko opzioak', the 720 successive-year and declared-account messages, m720.not_generated_left_out.

title: revolut: check the remaining stock tickers that collide with crypto symbols
description: #371 moved 17 verified US tickers (META, U, H, M, ...) out of KNOWN_CRYPTO_SYMBOLS. About 25 more symbols in src/parsers/crypto-symbols.ts are plausible stock tickers too: STX, ELF, DASH, CAKE, COMP, FORM, SAFE, CC, BC, NAT, REAL, PI, SUN, SKY, ALT, EXOD, PUMP, LAB, DOG, TAC, FF, MX, LION, BEAT, RAIL. Check each against what Revolut actually lists as a stock vs a coin before moving any (some are real coins Revolut offers).

title: trade-republic: turn mergers and free shares into lot transfers and income
description: Since #349 Trade Republic mergers and free shares only warn. Follow-up: a same-date MERGER pair becomes a cost-carrying lot transfer, and FREE_RECEIPT becomes income plus a lot at its market value. The engine's TC merger path only works from IBKR-format data today.

title: degiro: carry lots over on an ISIN change or share exchange instead of only warning
description: Since #345 a Degiro ISIN change, split or share exchange booked as a same-day sale + buy pair only gets a warning; the disposal and the stepped-up lot are still computed, so a plain ISIN change or an EU FEAC canje is taxed until the user fixes it by hand. Follow-up: turn the pair into a CorporateAction that carries the lots (cost and dates) to the new ISIN, with an opt-out for a taxable canje (art. 37.1.e LIRPF).

title: web: the missing-holdings notice ignores the year being shown
description: findMissingHoldings (src/web/missing-holdings.ts) decides per file whether a broker has year-end holdings, without the active year, while yearEndHoldings keeps only files ending at that year's 31 December. An IBKR file for last year (with positions) plus an IBKR trades-only file for this year: viewing this year, IBKR is not named, and 720 falls back to 'Sube un informe con posiciones'. The merge.holdings_other_date warning covers it today. Fix: compute 'missing' from holdingsBySource filtered to the active year.

title: web: a profile setting changed during the first calculation does not trigger a rerun
description: The profilechange listener in src/web/main.ts only reruns when currentReport is set. processFiles reads the profile at the start of the run, so ticking monodivisa in Perfil while the first step 2->3 run is still going leaves the results on the old setting (the header shows the setting actually used, so nothing is silently wrong). Same after a failed rerun, where currentReport is null but old results stay on screen. Fix: gate on mergedStatement && lastRunSettings only, and set lastRunSettings = null in resetDownstream so a profile edit on step 2 does not start a run. Test: change a setting while a gated buildEcbRateMap is pending.

title: web: small follow-ups from the design PRs
description: Non-blocking review notes: (1) manual-rates.ts savedElsewhere compares the stored, normalized currency with the raw u.currency; build the key with normalizeManualQuote like storedRateFor (#363). (2) contrast.test.ts guard only sees white text and its background in the same rule; a :hover rule that sets only a background slips past (#373). (3) the wash-sale detail row shifts the tbody zebra parity below it; fmtDay duplicates formatDate; the summary cites 'art. 33.5' where docs use 33.5.f (#375). (4) m720.sold_help says every sold ISIN goes in with origin C, but one with an invalid old code is left out and listed under omissions; loadPrevious720 compares against getProfile().year, not cachedYear (#376).
